name: 33916 · Fort Myers, FL
findings: ZIP 33916 (Fort Myers) has 76 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33916 (Fort Myers) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33916 (Fort Myers) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).
